choices.name: community — public and open-join, rules gate, moderation depth

options.name: create-channel
options.description: Create a text channel (hidden from @everyone until you set overwrites yourself).

options.name: category
options.description: Optional category to place it under

options.name: delete-channel
options.description: Delete a channel. Requires `confirm:true` (non-destructive by default).

options.name: assign-role
options.description: Assign a role to a member.

options.name: remove-role
options.description: Remove a role from a member.

options.name: move-member
options.description: Move a member to another voice channel (both need Move Members).

options.name: purge
options.description: Bulk-delete recent messages. Requires `confirm:true` and Manage Messages.

name: webhook
description: Emit the incoming-webhook setup guide for a channel.

name: forum
description: Parent — Discord forces a subcommand; this body is unreachable wiring.

options.name: draft
options.description: Ephemeral tag suggestions + first-post template (no channel mutate).

options.name: details
options.description: Optional details for the template body

options.name: post
options.description: Create a `#help` (or chosen forum) post via Discord's forum-thread API.

options.name: perms
options.description: Snapshot the bot's forum overwrite, then gap-fill missing required bits only.

options.name: apply
options.description: When true, PUT the gap-filled bot member overwrite

name: remember
description: Store a durable fact about a member (yourself by default).

options.name: fact
options.description: A single concise fact, stated in third person

options.name: user
options.description: Who it is about (default: you; moderators may choose another member)

options.name: replaces
options.description: An existing fact this replaces — it is removed only because you said so

name: forget
description: Forget one of your stored facts.

options.name: user
options.description: Who it is about (default: you; moderators may choose another member)

name: pending
description: Review or resolve supersessions the model proposed but never applied.

options.name: list
options.description: Show supersessions proposed for a member, with nothing removed yet.

options.name: user
options.description: Who to review (default: you; moderators may choose another member)

options.name: confirm
options.description: Apply one proposed supersession, removing the old fact.

options.name: user
options.description: Who it is about (default: you; moderators may choose another member)

options.name: dismiss
options.description: Drop one proposed supersession, keeping both facts.

options.name: user
options.description: Who it is about (default: you; moderators may choose another member)

name: recall
description: What Abbey remembers about a member, and their standing.

options.name: user
options.description: Who to look up (default: you; moderators may choose another member)

name: reputation
description: Your standing privately, or another member when authorized.

name: summarize
description: Summarize the recent messages Abbey has seen in this channel.

choices.name: abbey — warm sharp friend and default

name: see
description: Describe an image — and answer a question about it if you ask one.

name: ocr
description: Transcribe the text in an image.

name: stats
description: Learning and reply-budget statistics for this server or your DM.

name: admin
description: Configure Abbey for this server.

options.name: show
options.description: Show current settings with a classic page select into the admin dashboard.

options.name: persona
options.description: Set the default persona for this server.

choices.name: abbey — warm sharp friend and default

options.name: learning
options.description: Toggle adaptive learning (the DQN) for this server.

options.name: nsfw
options.description: Toggle Aviva `/roleplay` for this server (NSFW channels only when on).

options.name: vision
options.description: Toggle image understanding for this server.

options.name: cooldown
options.description: Minimum seconds between unsolicited replies in a channel (0–600).

options.name: act
options.description: Opt Abbey into unsolicited replies in this server (not guild mutations — use `/server …` for those).

options.name: budget
options.description: Unsolicited actions allowed per hour in this server (1–60).

options.name: brain
options.description: Inspect this server's policy: ε, steps, buffer fill, experiences.

options.name: epsilon
options.description: Override exploration ε (0–1); omit to show

options.name: export
options.description: Export this server's brain snapshot as JSON.

options.name: reset
options.description: Reset this channel's conversation memory (the multi-turn transcript).

options.name: dashboard
options.description: Open the owner- and guild-bound classic administration dashboard.

options.name: quarantine
options.description: Mark a member's stored fact as suspect in the ledger. It stays visible.

options.name: contradict
options.description: Record that two of a member's stored facts contradict each other. Both stay.

options.name: counterpart
options.description: The fact it contradicts, as stored

options.name: resolve
options.description: Close an open memory review with a verdict. Deletes nothing.

options.name: edge
options.description: The edge digest from the quarantine reply

name: nsfw
description: Toggle Aviva `/roleplay` in this DM (personal one-person guild settings).

name: roleplay
description: Roleplay as Aviva when the NSFW gate allows it (bot DM or NSFW guild channel).

name: voice
description: Voice listen (consent), status, and macOS music mirror (`play` / `pause` / `stop-music`).

options.name: play
options.description: Mirror host Spotify/Music into Abbey's voice channel (macOS tap). Does not grant listen consent.

options.name: query
options.description: Spotify URI or Music search; omit to mirror what is already playing

options.name: pause
options.description: Pause mirrored music and close host capture. Listening consent is unchanged.

options.name: resume-music
options.description: Resume mirrored music only. Never renews listen consent.

options.name: stop-music
options.description: Stop host capture and mirrored playback. Listening consent is unchanged.

options.name: volume
options.description: Set mirrored music volume (0–100). Abbey speech ducks music to one quarter.

options.name: join
options.description: Start the configured voice backend after everyone present was notified.

options.name: consent
options.description: Confirm everyone present was notified and consented

options.name: resume
options.description: Resume after a new participant was notified and consented.

options.name: consent
options.description: Confirm everyone now present was notified and consented

options.name: leave
options.description: Stop processing synchronously and leave Discord voice.

options.name: status
options.description: Show the member-safe voice state without operational diagnostics.

options.name: diagnostics
options.description: Show content-free operational detail to current server managers.

options.name: verify
options.description: Arm or read a content-free live acceptance run.

options.name: start
options.description: Start one local, content-free acceptance run before the consented join.

options.name: report
options.description: Render the current redacted acceptance report without ending the run.

options.name: mode
options.description: Show or change the voice backend in force. Requires MANAGE_GUILD.

options.name: mode
options.description: Off or Local. Omit to show the current mode.

options.name: consent
options.description: Review your saved voice choice and agree or withdraw privately.

options.name: notice
options.description: Post the current member choice notice in the configured voice channel.
